qualifications.name: Bachelor of Dental Surgery
notes: Programme scope: Five-year Dental Surgery degree for the dentist route in private dental practice, public oral health services, academic dentistry and specialist dental pathways.

Eligibility explanation: NSC applicants need APS 37, Mathematics Level 6, Physical Sciences Level 6, Life Sciences Level 6, English Level 5, Life Orientation Level 5, one additional subject at Level 5 and one additional subject at Level 4.

Selection context: The official page describes phased pre-selection from Grade 11 results and final Grade 12 selection. Pre-selection does not guarantee a place, and final selection is competitive by merit and available spaces.

Space context: The live SMU page lists 42 BDS first-year spaces during the second selection phase, including places for first-time entrants, top SMU science/medicine/ECP students, SADC applicants, SMU graduates and relevant science or health sciences degree holders.

Transfer and graduate context: Top SMU BSc I, MBChB I and BSc-ECP II students may be considered for limited BDS I places, with high academic performance expectations. Completed degree applicants are scored using published transcript and postgraduate-degree rules.

Foreign applicant context: SADC applicants from countries not offering dentistry need relevant matriculation or examination results, a matric exemption certificate issued through the relevant South African authority, and proof of identification.

Document checklist: Prepare identity document or passport, Grade 11 and final Grade 12 results, proof of school-leaving qualification, USAf/SAQA or matric exemption documents where applicable, academic transcripts for transfer/graduate routes, and any School of Dentistry documents requested by SMU.

Application method: Apply through official SMU undergraduate application channels and follow School of Dentistry selection communication; the dean does not allocate admission spaces outside the selection process.
Closing-date context: Confirm the current SMU undergraduate deadline for the admission year. Dentistry final offers depend on Grade 12 results, ranking and available places.
Application safety: Do not pay anyone promising guaranteed BDS admission, reserved spaces or transfer into dentistry. Confirm all offers through official SMU channels.
Source reviewed: Official SMU Dentistry Undergraduate Admission Requirements page and SMU Prospectus 2026/2027 booklet, pages 16-17, reviewed on 31 July 2026.
Source confidence: High - official SMU website and official SMU prospectus.

qualifications.name: Bachelor of Dental Therapy
notes: Programme scope: Three-year Dental Therapy degree. Dental therapists perform basic procedures such as tooth extractions, cleaning and polishing teeth, and dental X-rays.

Eligibility explanation: NSC applicants need APS 28, Mathematics Level 4, Physical Sciences Level 4, Life Sciences Level 4, English Level 4, Life Orientation Level 4, and two additional subjects at Level 4.
Selection context: Provisional admission is based on Grade 11 results, final selection uses Grade 12 performance, and applicants must maintain or improve the required subject and APS levels.
Space context: The live SMU page lists a total of 25 Dental Therapy students per academic year. Selection is competitive and meeting the minimum criteria does not guarantee admission.

Transfer and graduate context: SMU or other university transfer/graduate applicants have limited reserved spaces and need strong university performance, including a published 65% average rule where applicable.
Foreign applicant context: SADC applicants are managed through official university processes and must meet criteria compatible with admitted applicants.

Document checklist: Prepare identity document or passport, Grade 11 and final Grade 12 results, proof of school-leaving qualification, USAf/SAQA or matric exemption documents where applicable, and academic transcripts for transfer/graduate routes.
Application method: Apply through official SMU undergraduate application channels and follow School of Dentistry selection communication.
Closing-date context: Confirm the current SMU undergraduate deadline for the admission year. Final offers depend on Grade 12 results, ranking and space.
Application safety: Do not pay anyone promising Dental Therapy admission, reserved seats or transfer placement. Use official SMU communication only.
Source reviewed: Official SMU Dentistry Undergraduate Admission Requirements page and SMU Prospectus 2026/2027 booklet, pages 16-17, reviewed on 31 July 2026.
Source confidence: High - official SMU website and official SMU prospectus.

qualifications.name: Bachelor of Oral Hygiene
notes: Programme scope: Three-year Oral Hygiene degree. Oral hygienists are trained in cleaning and polishing teeth, taking X-rays, preventative oral-health procedures and oral-health promotion.

Eligibility explanation: The Mathematics route needs APS 28 with Mathematics Level 4. The Mathematical Literacy route needs APS 31 with Mathematical Literacy Level 7. Both routes require Physical Sciences Level 4, Life Sciences Level 4, English Level 4, Life Orientation Level 4, and two additional subjects at Level 4.
Selection context: Provisional admission is based on Grade 11 results, final selection uses Grade 12 performance, and applicants must maintain or improve the required subject and APS levels.

Transfer and graduate context: SMU or other university transfer/graduate applicants have limited reserved spaces and need strong university performance, including a published 65% average rule where applicable.
Foreign applicant context: SADC applicants are managed through official university processes and must meet criteria compatible with admitted applicants.

Document checklist: Prepare identity document or passport, Grade 11 and final Grade 12 results, proof of school-leaving qualification, USAf/SAQA or matric exemption documents where applicable, and academic transcripts for transfer/graduate routes.
Application method: Apply through official SMU undergraduate application channels and follow School of Dentistry selection communication.

Source reviewed: Official SMU Dentistry Undergraduate Admission Requirements page and SMU Prospectus 2026/2027 booklet, page 17, reviewed on 31 July 2026.
